description: A house-style chart.json that breaks the chart profile schema or a check's options schema (allowed-type without types, a token reference with no token source, an unknown field, a value out of range) is left out with an issue saying why, so check_chart_style runs no checks.

style.toString: an Object.prototype name, refused like any unknown property (#766)

issues.message: chart.json is left out: palette[1]: "brand/primary" is a token reference, but this host has no design tokens to resolve it. theme.background: a token reference is { "$token": "<variable name or id>", "mode"?: "<mode>" }. /palette/1: Expected string, got undefined. /theme/fontSize: Must be >= 6. /extra: Unknown property "extra". Allowed: palette, colorSchemes, layouts, theme, defaults, three. /toString: Unknown property "toString". Allowed: palette, colorSchemes, layouts, theme, defaults, three. checks[2] (allowed-type)/types: Missing required property "types". checks[3] (min-contrast)/ratio: Must be <= 21. checks[3] (min-contrast)/other: Unknown property "other". Allowed: ratio. checks[5]: expected a check id or { "id": ..., options }.
